prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: Dr. Vick Gupta, Gupta Smile Studio
engine_stated_criteria: two or three orthodontists who are orthodontic specialists
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—the right choice depends on your case, location, budget, and whether you prefer braces or aligners. I’d start by comparing **two or three orthodontists who are orthodontic specialists**, then choose after an in-person consultation.

A few Dallas options to consider:

- **Dr. Vick Gupta, Gupta Smile Studio** — offers both braces and Invisalign; the practice says he is board-certified. [Practice website](https://www.guptasmilestudio.com/)
- **Dr. Nathan Harris** — listed by the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO); office near Preston Road. [AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-nathan-harris/)
- **Dr. Casey Lepley** — listed by the AAO, with Dallas-area offices. [AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-casey-lepley-2/)
- **Dr. Bryan S. Elvebak** — listed by the AAO; office in North Dallas. [AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-bryan-s-elvebak/)

At consultations, ask who will supervise your treatment, whether braces and Invisalign are both suitable for *your* bite, what’s included in the quoted fee (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. The AAO locator is a useful way to verify specialist credentials and find more nearby options: [Find an orthodontist](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).
